explication: Kestra is an event-driven orchestration platform for data, AI, and infrastructure workflows. The main path is defining a flow, triggering an execution, coordinating task and worker execution, and retaining execution artifacts and state. The README also describes Git-oriented flow management, plugins, AI agents/RAG, and MCP; these appear as capability branches where the tree supports paths. Several links reflect documented product behavior rather than inspected call sites, since most implementation excerpts were partial or absent.
